_note: Life stages, births, aging and migration (DESIGN.md, Population growth). Days are game days; a game day is a real minute at 1x.

births._note: Births need a working clinic, a happy enough hole and a free bed.

school._note: Each unschooled child upsets their family (familySize people, child included): comfort falls in proportion, down to unschooledComfort when every family is affected.

elderCare._note: Elders without a place in elder care, plus someone looking after each, weigh on health.

migration._note: Once a day, adults in an unhappy hole may leave for a clearly happier one with free beds. They travel at rover speed.
